en.headline: Police seize about 9kg of suspected cannabis from mainland man at airport
en.dek: A 22-year-old man was arrested on Sunday morning after officers found roughly 30 packs of cannabis flowers in his luggage and backpack, with an estimated street value of HK$1.3 million.
body: Police said officers from the West Kowloon anti-triad unit, acting on intelligence, intercepted a man at the arrival hall of Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday morning.
A search of his suitcase and backpack uncovered about 30 packs of suspected cannabis flowers weighing roughly 9 kilograms, with an estimated market value of HK$1.3 million.

The 22-year-old mainland man was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs and is being detained for further investigation. Police reminded the public that trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 機場截查22歲內地男 檢約9公斤懷疑大麻花 市值130萬
zh.dek: 西九龍反三合會人員周日早上在入境大堂截查，於男子行李箱及背包內檢獲約30包懷疑大麻花，他涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。
body: 警方表示，西九龍總區反三合會行動組人員根據情報分析，周日早上聯同相關部門在香港國際機場入境大堂截查一名男子。
搜查其隨身行李箱及背包後，檢獲約30包、共重約9公斤的懷疑大麻花，估計市值約130萬元。
該名22歲內地男子涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕，現正被扣留調查。警方重申，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
